title: Discover: the memory's Agent Card
description: Served at https://memory.example.com/.well-known/agent-card.json. The Mem2A entry in capabilities.extensions is what marks this agent as a Mem2A memory.

agentCard.name: Example Corp memory
agentCard.description: Example Corp's shared company memory. Tell it what you are about to do and for whom; it tells you what you need to know first, and calls back if that changes.

extensions.description: Mem2A: negotiate before acting, listen for changes, commit after acting.

openIdConnectSecurityScheme.description: Example Corp sign-in. Agents present a delegated token that names both the agent and the person it acts for (OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange, RFC 8693).

skills.name: Negotiate
skills.description: Before acting, send an intent (what, which things, for whom). Get back a dossier, a question, or a refusal.

skills.name: Commit
skills.description: After acting, report what you did against the dossier version you relied on.
